test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
8 persons D, E, F, G, H, I, J and K are sitting around a square table, facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). Four persons are sitting at the corners and four persons are sitting at the middle of the sides of the square table. D is sitting at one side and opposite to K. G is sitting at a corner and to the immediate right of D. D is the immediate neighbour of E and G. I is not the immediate neighbour of H. F is sitting at one side and opposite to H.

Who is sitting just diagonally opposite to I?
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

1) D is sitting at one side and opposite to K.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/196dfa7a322ebe2b89bd0cb5eaa4c0b12dd3c935c0738d7dfb5ad729e3f6f7ad.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/26a64845f5ecc743070cfd512041fbc9f80d728058ed11371af49de87ee14d7c.png] 

2) G is sitting at a corner and to the immediate right of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d34ed4ebcec4c08b40f00dcbf76f1390138bf3e8a2c90bdc9f35ac9b944e54a3.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d1405113881d6a0bd4bf40f1c9d120ec72e52d503be0adddcb17dd48a9058462.png] 

3) D is the immediate neighbour of E and G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1abca232720809a66e8647c961abf6598c74053f8f70ff4a2f7f080e44faac24.png] 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2bee2ca5c8682be78fa9c2483d649d0953fcb1c500fbacbb05567a8d5cd11531.png] 

4) F is sitting at one side and opposite to H.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a8adf504ae532d068c6544e47f01524940a914684d585abe3b7d0f4fae27545a.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4163c0a9e3f9f47f8f0ae89411d754068030205158789806b8efeb770f518444.png] 

5) I is not the immediate neighbour of H.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/35f96026370c3945e5564b2d0f7be22fc9396d9c147f5efd88d6189191d39818.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bdad29d4a9d1778fbd608e979c7f28f7645430b40fc0f23e1e5aa66d889167d0.png] 

Clearly, in all cases **E **sits diagonally opposite to **I.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"E".**
